_templateNotes: Copy this file to a new label file such as curl_001.json, then edit the paths, split, expectedReps, and reps.
Use issueIds from availableIssues. Use an empty issueIds array for a clean rep.
Files named _template.json or *.template.json are ignored by dataset:evaluate and dataset:optimize.

reps.notes: Clean rep or describe the visible form issue.

notes: Draft label template. Copy to a real label file, review timings/issues, then set reviewStatus to reviewed.

availableIssues.feedbackMessage: Flex more at the top of the curl.
Incomplete rep — curl all the way up and fully extend.
Too much shoulder involvement — reduce the weight.
Upper arms moving — keep elbows pinned to your sides.
Excessive body swing — this is cheating the rep.
Don't swing your torso — stay upright and controlled.
Control the lowering — don't drop the weight.
Arms are uneven — curl both sides together.
Keep your elbows in — don't flare them out to the sides.
Tuck your elbows in — they're drifting outward.
